scripts.dev: bun run prepare:sidecars && cargo run --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml
scripts.build: bun run prepare:sidecars && cargo build --release --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml && bun test tests
scripts.build:installer: bun run prepare:sidecars && cd desktop && cargo packager --release
scripts.build:installer:mac: bun run prepare:sidecars && cd desktop && cargo packager --release --formats dmg
scripts.build:installer:mac:notarized: export APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE=cloud-drive-mount && bun run build:installer:mac && scripts/notarize-dmg.sh
scripts.build:installer:windows: bun run prepare:sidecars && cd desktop && cargo packager --release --formats wix
